open_calls.nenrin-provenance: A NENRIN provenance verifier by a further author, in any language, that reproduces the verdict signatures of interop-v0, interop-v0.1 and interop-v0.2/edge. Two so far, both by kuangmi-bit: workers/hs-ledger/nenrin/interop-v0/INTEROP.md

items.subject: a2a-card-canonical-form
items.what: An independent Go implementation reproduced the @a2a-js/sdk canonical form of the pinned HORIZON SHIELD gate card byte for byte (6410 bytes), offline from the committed fixture

items.subject: a2a-card-sign-v01
items.what: Scored a2a-sdk and a2a-python#1287 against the 24 signed vectors with an own harness that verifies the ES256 signatures directly against testkey_jwks.json, after reproducing MANIFEST.observed

items.subject: a2a-card-sign-v01
items.what: A verifier written only from A2A section 8.4.1 and the proto markings, sharing no code with the generator or the scorer: all 24 vectors come out as labelled, no false accepts

items.subject: a2a-card-sign-v01
items.what: Reproduced the s3 unknown-field results with an own harness at f427e46, including an experimental retain variant that scores 11/11 and rejects S3-T-011

items.subject: agent-card-signature
items.what: Re-verified the gate's agent card signature with their own verifier, 10/10, recording the digest our signing tool printed

items.subject: a2a-card-sign-v01
items.what: A separately implemented retained-field consumer, run against all 13 s3-unknown-fields cases: every outcome matches the a2a-go column of MANIFEST.observed, S3-D-012 accepted through its retained-form signature, S3-T-011 and S3-D-013 refused

items.subject: a2a-card-sign-v01
items.what: Published a served-scope verifier entry point for a2a-python that canonicalizes the received JSON and keeps members outside the schema (canonicalize_served_agent_card, create_served_card_signature_verifier, candidate/served-scope-1278 at 2491248); pinned as its own MANIFEST.observed column, all 37 vectors as labelled under rule-1-served-scope and unknown-retain, no false accepts

items.subject: a2a-card-sign-v01
items.what: A separately implemented received-JSON consumer, run against all five s4-dual-name cases under both dual-name-tolerate and dual-name-refuse: every outcome as labelled, including S4-REJECT-005 refused under both, with the corpus digests checked before execution

items.subject: nenrin-provenance
items.what: A NENRIN provenance verifier in Python written from the spec alone, without reading our source: reproduced all five interop-v0 verdict signatures and the 21 digests, and reported five places where the spec was unclear or wrong

items.subject: nenrin-provenance
items.what: A second, separate verifier built from the text of VERIFIER.md alone: 18 of 18 on interop-v0 and interop-v0.1 (8 of 18 for the build from the older text), then the 36 fixtures of interop-v0.2/edge (merged as PR #30), whose expectations it cut

third_party_ci_reproductions.method: GitHub search for repositories named like conduct-witness, kept when template_repository is ogasurfproject-jpg/conduct-witness-template and reproduce.yml has a successful run in the last 30 days

does_not_establish: a count is not a score or an endorsement
an implementation that reproduced bytes did not thereby adopt or approve anything
absent from these sources is not absent from the world
